name: Media Guard
description: Blocks a message that names a remote media URL, which the gateway would fetch from the host. Deterministic; blocks message calls it can't read.

mxcServers.description: Matrix server names whose mxc:// content URIs a message may use as media. Default: matrix.org.

extraMediaKeys.description: Extra message parameter names, added by a channel plugin, that carry a media source. Matched ignoring case, underscores and hyphens, at any depth.
